title: Sedans 2.5 launches full AI video workspace with 60-day unlimited #sedans25 #topviewcanvas #aivideo
description: TopView Canvas launched Sedans 2.5, an AI-driven video workspace that generates 30-second videos in one shot. Sedans 2.5 allows users to upload up to 50 reference images or videos, ensuring consistent style, product, or character across scenes. The platform builds storyboards and creates each scene automatically, offering precise clip editing for quick adjustments without redoing the entire video. This innovation streamlines video production, saving time and enhancing creativity for marketers, content creators, and brands looking to maintain style consistency at scale. #TopViewCanvas #Sedans2_5 #AIVideoGeneration #VideoEditing #ContentCreation #VideoProduction #AIStoryboarding #CreativeTech #MarketingInnovation #DigitalContent #VideoWorkspace #ClipEditing #VisualConsistency #AIworkflow #VideoMarketing
